scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the nonautonomous scalar model, its constant-release threshold construction, Theorem 2, the numerical parameter table, and the two crossing-threshold Figure 2 profiles. Open related two-sex periodic-release literature was inspected, and a later delayed stage–sex periodic-release article was checked through its accessible abstract and metadata. The bundled checker verifies the exact envelope algebra and independently reproduces the numerical period averages. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The average-envelope condition is sufficient rather than necessary and may be conservative because it maximizes the instantaneous per-capita birth term over all positive wild-female states. The numerical amplitude s_env is a threshold for this sufficient criterion, not a claimed sharp extinction threshold for the nonlinear nonautonomous model.

title: An averaged release criterion for the stage–sex sterile-mosquito model
